title: fix(rest): /discovery no longer contradicts itself — services.*.route follows the mounted paths
body:
Fixes #16674

`/discovery` states each service's address twice — `routes.X` (the flat convenience map) and `services.Y.route` (the per-slot entry). The REST discovery handler rewrote only the first half to the paths this server actually mounts, so any deployment that moved a prefix received a document that disagreed with itself, with the `services` half addressing a path nothing is mounted on.

This takes triage's **option 1**: the substitution pass is extended to the `services` block. `services.*.route` is written as a **projection of the finished `routes` map**, key by key, rather than a second computation of the same paths — the producer's own lesson from #14646 ("two derivations of one fact is how `routes` and `services` drift"), applied one key over.

## Measured, on the composition harness

Booting `createRestApiPlugin` over a recording host and reading the handler mounted at `GET {base}/discovery` — the card's own setup:

| boot | `routes.data` | `services.data.route` before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| default | `/api/v1/data` | `/api/v1/data` | `/api/v1/data` (unchanged) |
| `crud: { dataPrefix: '/objects' }` | `/api/v1/objects` | `/api/v1/data` | `/api/v1/objects` |
| `apiPath: '/backend/api/v9'` | `/backend/api/v9/data` | `/api/v1/data` | `/backend/api/v9/data` |

The `apiPath` boot moved four keys at once: `data`, `metadata`, `ui`, `auth` — the four the substitution pass rewrites.

Clause-②: no

The delivered diff corrects an output VALUE on a machine-readable surface and pulls it back to the address the deployment actually serves. It adds no schema key, no closed-set member, no registry row, and no published export: the one new symbol (`DISCOVERY_ROUTE_KEY_TO_SERVICE_SLOTS`) is a module-level export of `rest-server.ts`, and `packages/rest` publishes a single entry (`.` to `dist/index.js`) whose re-export list is named, not `export *`. `check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no` returns NOT MEASURED on every file in the diff (no declared surface covers them), so the direction claim above is a judgement, not a tool reading, and it is recorded here as one.

## Acceptance notes

The six-point rubric from the triage comment, verbatim, with how each was met.

> 1. **`services` 块整体过一遍，⛔ 不只是 `services.data`。** 本卡的实例是 data 键，但成因是"替换 pass 只覆盖 `routes.*`" —— 只补一个键，`services` 里其它同类字段仍然是写死的。承接 PR 请给出 `services.*` 里所有 route 形状字段的清单与各自处置，⛔ 不要留空。

The complete inventory of route-shaped fields under `services.*`, as the producer emits them (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`), and the disposition of each. Sixteen slots are emitted on a full boot; eleven declare a route.

| `services.*` slot | route it declares | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `data` | `/api/v1/data` | **mirrored** — rewritten by the pass (`crud.dataPrefix`); the card's instance |
| `metadata` | `/api/v1/meta` | **mirrored** — rewritten by the pass (`metadata.prefix`) |
| `ui` | `/api/v1/ui` | **mirrored** — rewritten by the pass (`{realBase}/ui`) |
| `auth` | `/api/v1/auth` | **mirrored** — rewritten by the pass (unscoped base) |
| `analytics` | `/api/v1/analytics` | in the table, **no-op today** — the producer derives `routes.analytics` FROM this field (#14646), and the pass never rewrites that key. Carried so a future substitution brings it along |
| `automation` | `/api/v1/automation` | same as `analytics` |
| `ai` | `/api/v1/ai` | same as `analytics` |
| `i18n` | `/api/v1/i18n` | same as `analytics` |
| `notification` | `/api/v1/notifications` | same as `analytics`; note the route key and the slot name are spelled differently, which is why the pairing is a table and not a name match |
| `storage` | `/api/v1/storage` | same as `analytics` |
| `file-storage` | mirror of `storage` | **mirrored with `storage`** — the deprecated v17 alias the producer copies VERBATIM off the canonical row (#9683). Updating only the canonical one would turn a byte-equal copy into a second opinion |
| `realtime` | occupant-named, or none | **mirrored when present.** The stock in-process bus names no channel route; no route is invented |
| `cache` | none | **untouched** — route-less by contract (in-process, #4318). Pinned: it must not gain one |
| `queue` | none | as `cache` |
| `job` | none | as `cache` |
| `search` | `/api/v1/search` | **untouched** — the mirror image of the others: a slot that declares a route with no `ApiRoutesSchema` key to follow, so there is nothing to project from |

Route keys with no slot behind them are absent from the table on purpose: `packages` (the `package` service is deliberately not a `CoreServiceName` slot, so no `services.package` entry exists, #6633), `datasources`, `email`, `mcp` and `discovery` (surfaces this server mounts itself, which the protocol's service map never described), and `approvals` (declared in `ApiRoutesSchema`, emitted by neither producer).

The table is not trusted to stay complete: `discovery-services-route-follows-mount.test.ts` re-derives the pairs from a real producer document (equal values name the pairs) and reds when one is missing, and a second case reds on a slot name the producer does not emit — a misspelled slot would otherwise be a silent no-op.

> 2. **两侧一致性断言**：同一份 discovery 文档里，`routes.X` 与 `services.X.route` 对同一个受配置影响的键必须**相等**。⛔ 不要分别断言两个字面量 —— 要断言的是"文档不自相矛盾"这件事本身。

`#16674 — routes.X and services.Y.route are one answer` compares the two halves of the **same served document** against each other, across three boots (default, moved prefixes, `apiPath`), and reports every disagreement by name. No literal appears in the comparison. The case carries its own anti-vacuity guard: the four rewritten keys must all be present and compared on every boot, so a document that simply stopped emitting them cannot pass.

> 3. **阴性对照必测**：默认配置（`dataPrefix = '/data'`、`metadata.prefix = '/meta'`）下，整份 discovery 文档在改动前后**逐字节相同**。一个"总是重写 services 块"的实现会让第 2 条绿，同时给每个默认部署引入一次无谓的差异。

Two halves, and this was built **before** the implementation so it constrained it.

- **Whole document, before against after, on one tree.** Measured at head `90527f18` by dumping `{ routes, services }` for three boots with the mirror in place, ablating the mirror step in the working tree, dumping again, and restoring — so main's own drift cannot enter the comparison. Default configuration: `diff` reports **no difference at all**. The moved-prefix boot differs in exactly 2 values (`services.data.route`, `services.metadata.route`); the `apiPath` boot in exactly 4 (`data`, `metadata`, `auth`, `ui`). Nothing else in either document moved. The restore leg is proven by blob hash (`28b3714c`, byte-identical to HEAD) with `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` both empty.
- **In the suite, permanently.** `leaves the default-configuration services block byte-identical to the producer` compares the served `services` block with the producer's own, `JSON.stringify` against `JSON.stringify` — key order and key presence included, which is what an "always rewrite" implementation disturbs while every agreement case stays green. `never invents a route on a slot that has no HTTP surface` reads the serialized document on a boot where the mirror is definitely working and pins `cache`, `queue`, `job` and `realtime` route-less.

The implementation earns that by construction: three guards — only a slot the producer emitted, only one that already declares a `route` string, and only from a route key that survived the pass. On a stock boot every write assigns the string that was already there.

> 4. **驱动腿**：复用卡面那套（`crud: { dataPrefix: '/objects' }` 起服务、读 `GET /api/v1/discovery`），断言 `services.data.route` 也变成 `/api/v1/objects`。⛔ 不要只做单元断言 —— 本卡是被驱动测出来的，回归也应当被驱动。

Every case in the new file is driven: `createRestApiPlugin(config).start(ctx)` composes the real plugin over a recording host, the document is served by the handler actually mounted at `GET {base}/discovery`, and the value under test is produced by the real `getDiscovery()` builder and rewritten by the real pass. The first case is the card's setup exactly — `crud: { dataPrefix: '/objects' }`, `GET /api/v1/discovery`, `services.data.route` is `/api/v1/objects` — and it carries the card's occurrence count as its negative half: the string `/api/v1/data` occurs zero times across `routes` and `services` on that boot. The harness idiom is `direct-mount-base-follows-apipath.test.ts`'s, this package's existing form for "the real composition".

> 5. `protocol.ts:5740` 的字面量 ⛔ **不动** —— 它作为默认值是对的；要动的是"它之后没有被带齐"这件事。若承接者认为生产者也该参数化，回本卡说明，⛔ 不要顺手改（那会把 `packages/metadata-protocol` 拉进本 PR 的验证面）。

Untouched. `packages/metadata-protocol` has no diff in this PR; the file list is three files, all under `packages/rest/src/` and `.changeset/`. The producer's literal remains the correct default, and the fix is entirely on the "it was never brought along" half. I do **not** think the producer should be parameterised: it cannot see the mount, which is the whole reason the correction belongs to the REST host that does.

One adjacent observation, filed nowhere and deliberately not acted on: on an `apiPath` deployment the seven route keys this pass does not rewrite (`analytics`, `automation`, `ai`, `i18n`, `notifications`, `storage`, plus `search` in the `services` half) keep the producer's `/api/v1/...` convention literals in **both** halves. Those are self-consistent, so they are not this card's subject, and whether each plugin's own mount follows `apiPath` is a fact none of this code can see. Noted here rather than filed — no carrier PR or person is on that path today.

> 6. 相邻卡 #4318（discovery 槽位声明的路由与自己的 `handlerReady` 矛盾）⛔ 不并入 —— 卡面已划清：那是"路由根本不存在"，本卡是"路由存在但在别处"。

Not merged in. The mirror never withdraws an advertisement: a deleted or absent `routes.X` leaves the slot's route alone rather than blanking it, and a route-less slot never gains one. Withdrawing an advertisement because nothing is mounted is the ADR-0076 D12 question #4318 owns, and the guard comment in `rest-server.ts` says so at the site.

## Reverse verification

Run from the committed state, mutating the MIRROR STEP only and leaving the pairing table exported — so the pin fails behaviourally rather than on a missing import, which would prove only that the file can be broken.

On-disk proof of the mutation before anything was read: `advertisedServices` 3 occurrences to 0, the injected `ABLATED-MIRROR` marker 1, blob `28b3714c` to `6728cb2d`.

Direction: **5 red, 5 green** — and which five is the reading.

- Red: the three driven prefix cases (`dataPrefix`, `metadata.prefix`, `apiPath`) and the two moved-prefix agreement cases. Sample diagnostic: `routes.data=/api/v1/objects vs services.data.route=/api/v1/data`, and `routes.metadata=/api/v1/metadata vs services.metadata.route=/api/v1/meta` — the card's defect, reported by the pin.
- Green: the default-configuration agreement case, **both negative controls**, and both table-completeness pins. That the negative controls stay green under ablation is the point of running it this way: they are controls on the implementation, not consequences of it.

Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD -- packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, then blob back to `28b3714c` (byte-identical to HEAD), `git diff HEAD` empty and `git status --porcelain` empty. The mutation script carried a `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` restore throughout.

No rebuild was needed on either leg and none was skipped: the pin imports the subject relatively (`./rest-api-plugin.js`, `./rest-server.js`), so it resolves this package's SOURCE, not its `dist/`. The one unaliased artifact import it makes is `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` — the producer, which this PR does not touch — and that pair is already registered in `check-test-source-alias`'s `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` for `@objectstack/rest`.

## The sibling pin this moves, and why that is not a weakening

`discovery-per-request-protocol.test.ts` (#9292) proves `/discovery` follows the REQUEST's kernel by comparing the served document's `services` map against the raw `getDiscovery()` of the environment's own protocol. Mirroring the mounted paths puts a handler overlay on that value: on a scoped request `services.data.route` now reads `/api/v1/environments/tenant-a/data`, which the producer — who cannot see a mount — will never say. That is the correct address, and it is exactly what `routes.data` says on the same request.

`substance()` in that file already reduces `capabilities` to its `enabled` bits for this precise reason, in its own words: *"Those overlays are a different contract with its own pins; comparing whole descriptors here would make this file assert them too."* The route value now gets the same reduction, and the kernel-determined half is kept explicitly — whether the slot advertises an address at all (`advertisesRoute`), a fact the mirror never changes since it neither invents a route on a route-less slot nor withdraws one.

⛔ Nothing was skipped, disabled or quarantined: all four `toEqual` / `not.toEqual` halves still run, all four negative halves still separate the three protocols, and the file's other 8 cases are untouched. The overlay itself is not unpinned — it moved next door, where it is asserted against `routes.X` in the same served document.

## Files changed

- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` — the pairing table and the mirror step (+100)
- `packages/rest/src/discovery-services-route-follows-mount.test.ts` — new, 10 cases (+351)
- `packages/rest/src/discovery-per-request-protocol.test.ts` — `substance()` reduced past the mount projection
- `.changeset/discovery-services-route-follows-mount.md` — `@objectstack/rest`: patch

Plus one merge of `origin/main` (`776d64cd`), taken so the gate derivation stops reading stale copies of two checker files. It brings no conflict and touches nothing under `packages/rest/`.
